assertions.sql: SELECT name, category, price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY price DESC)::int AS nr FROM products ORDER BY category, nr

WITH kampagne AS (SELECT name, CASE WHEN name = 'Espresso' THEN 25.00 ELSE price END AS pris FROM products) SELECT name, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pris)::int AS rang FROM kampagne ORDER BY rang, name
assertions.message: Del 2: Delt placering for Espresso og Te på kampagnelisten
